model_tests.scope: Python symbolic protocol only; not native allocation/consumption/effects/network or callback isolation

review_corrections: Full inventory is not universally failure: respect the route's permitted drop/ejection destinations.
Include preparation/allocation RNG and native hooks in the effect/abort contract; a copied Menu is not their rollback.
unproven_assumptions: A native authority owner and generation/exclusive-borrow mechanism covers every relevant mutation.
Real native allocation can be staged and installed under one protected boundary.
Native RNG/hooks/maps/world ejection can obey an explicit tested abort and effect order.
Action-time results differing from preview can be correctly synchronized on supported clients.
